notes: Hand-painted wall sign of 'Samikaran Academic Coaching' (Dhaka), frontal and sharp. The business name and address are Bengali only; the only Latin text is the exam acronyms 'SSC, HSC' and the phone numbers, so it is labelled negative. Bengali digits in the year and house number (১৫৩), Western digits in the phone numbers. The row of dots after চলছে is five dots on the sign.

notes: Giant butterfly-shaped name sign of Butterfly Park Bangladesh, Patenga (Chattogram); 'Butterfly Park' is in a decorative script with oversized B and P. The red banner below ('প্রজা...পার্ক / BUTTERFLY PARK', i.e. প্রজাপতি পার্ক) is partly hidden by leaves; the small 'স্বাগতম / বন বিভাগ' plate and restaurant poster are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Francisco Anzola
attribution: Photo: Francisco Anzola, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/10345599@N03/31241856521. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Vertical green building sign in a crowded Old Dhaka lane, one letter cluster per row (ম / রি / য় / ম / প্লা / জা), crossed by overhead wires; rickshaw passenger in the foreground. A mark above the first ম may be a chandrabindu or a wire; it is not transcribed. The two-line address under the name (ending 'ঢাকা-১২১১') is too small to read.
source_title: At the end of the day
